Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is genuinely, deeply convinced that AI is transforming the way software gets built, and who wants to make that transformation happen at Filigran.

We are looking for an engineer first. This isn't a "we bought Copilot, please roll it out" role, and it isn't only a tooling or development role either: part of the job is building, part of it is trying things on real work, measuring them and telling teams honestly what works and what doesn't. This is a practitioner role for someone who has already lived this shift, who experiments constantly, who knows what works and what doesn't, and who can bring 60 engineers along on that journey.

You will join the XTM Foundation team as Filigran's internal reference on AI-Native engineering. You'll propose our approach, build our practices, run experiments, and share the results so that teams can change how they work with confidence. You'll be hands-on, opinionated, and always one step ahead.

💼 Your Responsibilities

  • Define and own Filigran's AI-Native engineering strategy: which tools, which workflows, which practices, and how they evolve as the landscape moves fast.

  • Run structured experiments to evaluate new AI coding tools and agents (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Cline, MCP servers, code generation agents…), measure their real impact on velocity and quality, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

  • Build the guardrails and engineering standards that ensure AI-generated code is maintainable, tested, and consistent with our quality bar — not just fast to produce.

  • Work directly with product engineering teams (~80 engineers) to embed AI practices into their day-to-day workflows: pair programming with AI, AI-assisted code review, test generation, documentation, and beyond.

  • Share what you learn. Run internal talks, workshops, and demos. Be the person engineers come to when they want to understand what's possible, and what isn't. Show real results, including the failures.

  • Stay permanently ahead of the curve — the AI tooling landscape moves weekly. You'll be the one tracking it, filtering the noise, and surfacing what actually matters for a team like ours.

  • Work in the XTM Foundation team to turn AI practices into shared building blocks for every product team: agent workflows in our CI pipelines (dependency updates, flaky test triage, review assistance), shared MCP servers and prompt libraries, versioned AI configuration in the repositories, and written rules on tools and data handling that apply to everyone.

  • Contribute to Filigran's external voice on AI-Native engineering — blog posts, open-source contributions, conference talks — as the opportunity arises.

🤝 Who You'll Work With

  • Reports to: Principal Engineer of XTM Foundation team.

  • Key collaborators: Engineers and Engineering Managers across OpenCTI, OpenAEV, and OpenGRC product teams; VP of Technology; CTO.

  • Working model: You will split your time between XTM Foundation team work (research, experimentation, standards) and direct collaboration with product teams to embed AI practices in real engineering workflows.

🧬 Profile We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience — you are a strong engineer first. You understand what good code looks like, and that's what makes your judgment on AI credible.

  • You are genuinely AI-first in how you work. Not as a trend, not as a productivity hack. You've already transformed how you build software, you can show what you built and what you measured, and you want to help others do the same.

  • Proven experience deploying AI-assisted development practices within an engineering team: you've done this before, you know what resistance looks like, and you know what actually works and what doesn't.

  • Deep, hands-on familiarity with the current AI coding tooling landscape: agentic coding tools, LLM-powered code review, prompt engineering for development workflows, MCP ecosystems, and what's coming next.

  • Strong full-stack engineering background — you can evaluate AI output across the whole stack and contribute code yourself when it matters.

  • You can make a clear case, with evidence. You're a natural communicator who can discuss a trade-off with a skeptical senior engineer just as well as you can help a junior developer get started.

  • Comfortable working in a remote-first, async culture with teams across multiple time zones; clear communicator in English.

  • Autonomy and ownership mindset: you drive this agenda without waiting for direction, and you bring others with you rather than working alone.

  • Bonus: experience with open-source communities, cybersecurity domain knowledge, contributions to AI tooling projects, or public writing/speaking on AI-Native engineering.

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect

  • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

  • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

  • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

  • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

  • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify.

🚀 Ready to Join Us?

Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE

Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation.

Au sein du Département Automatique, Productique et Informatique, le poste sera associé à l’équipe TASC (Théorie, Algorithmes et Systèmes en Contraintes ) dont les thématiques de recherche s’articulent autour de la programmation par contraintes, de la théorie aux applications en passant par l’hybridation. Dans ce cadre, le poste a pour objectif de venir en soutien au développement du solveur de contraintes choco-solver (http://choco-solver.org) maintenu par l’équipe TASC.

 

MISSIONS

Sous la responsabilité fonctionnelle du responsable du projet et développeur principal de la plateforme Choco-solver et en collaboration avec les membres de l’équipe TASC, les missions principales du poste sont :

  1.   Adapter l’algorithme bimodal aux contraintes reposant sur des parcours en profondeur, telles que GlobalCardinality, StableKeysort ou Circuit ;

  2.   Étudier la transposition des bénéfices de l’approche bimodale au cœur d’un solveur de contraintes (p. ex. le moteur de propagation) ;

  3.   Évaluer l’impact des explications paresseuses (lazy) dans les contraintes Sum et AllDifferent, entre autres ;

  4.   Participer à la rédaction d’articles scientifiques liés à ces sujets.

 

 ACTIVITÉS : Activité par mission

 

  1.      Adapter l’algorithme bimodal aux contraintes reposant sur des parcours en profondeur

·       Analyse les algorithmes de filtrage de GlobalCardinality, StableKeysort et Circuit disponibles dans choco-solver et identifie les parcours en profondeur (composantes fortement connexes, chemins alternants, etc.) susceptibles de bénéficier de l’approche bimodale

·       Conçoit et implémente en Java les variantes bimodales de ces algorithmes, en garantissant le niveau de cohérence attendu

·     Vérifie la correction des implémentations par des tests unitaires et des tests aléatoires comparant les résultats avec les propagateurs existants

·       Mesure les gains obtenus (temps de filtrage, passage à l’échelle) sur des jeux d’instances de référence (XCSP3, MiniZinc Challenge)

·       Intègre les développements validés dans la version publique de choco-solver (revue de code, documentation, intégration continue)

 

2.      Étudier la transposition des bénéfices de l’approche bimodale au cœur d’un solveur de contraintes

·       Étudie le fonctionnement interne de choco-solver (moteur de propagation, ordonnancement des propagateurs, gestion des événements) afin d’identifier les mécanismes pouvant tirer parti d’une stratégie bimodale

·       Propose et prototype une ou plusieurs adaptations, par exemple un basculement dynamique entre modes de propagation

·       Évalue expérimentalement ces prototypes et analyse les compromis entre coût et bénéfice

 

3.      Évaluer l’impact des explications paresseuses (

·       Implémente ou étend la génération paresseuse d’explications pour les contraintes Sum, AllDifferent et d’autres contraintes globales

·       Compare les explications paresseuses aux explications calculées pendant la propagation (taille des clauses apprises, temps de résolution, nombre de nœuds explorés)

·       Conçoit et conduit un protocole expérimental reproductible, puis analyse et synthétise les résultats

 

4.      Participer à la rédaction d’articles scientifiques liés à ces sujets.

·       Rédige en anglais des articles scientifiques présentant les contributions, en vue de soumissions à des conférences (CP, IJCAI, AAAI, CPAIOR) ou revues (Constraints) internationales

·       Prépare les artefacts expérimentaux associés (code, scripts, données) afin d’assurer la reproductibilité des résultats

·       Présente les travaux en séminaire d’équipe et, le cas échéant, en conférence

 


FORMATION ET COMPÉTENCES :

Niveau de formation et/ou expérience minimums requis :

·       Diplôme Bac + 5 ou équivalent

·       Diplôme Bac + 4 ou équivalent avec expérience professionnelle ≥ 4 ans

·       Diplôme Bac + 3 ou équivalent avec expérience professionnelle ≥ 6 ans

Compétences, connaissances et expériences indispensables :

·       Solide maîtrise de la programmation par contraintes, en particulier des algorithmes de filtrage des contraintes globales (cohérence d’arc généralisée)

·       Très bonne connaissance de l’algorithmique des graphes : parcours en profondeur, composantes fortement connexes, couplages et flots

·       Maîtrise avancée de Java et expérience du développement au sein de choco-solver (architecture interne, propagateurs, moteur de propagation)

·       Expérience de la conception et de la conduite d’évaluations expérimentales rigoureuses d’algorithmes

jobs.title: Alternant·e Growth Marketing Manager | Thiga Academy
jobs.description:
Alternance · Paris 9e · Télétravail · rythme d’alternance souhaité 3 semaines entreprise / 1 semaine école 
 
Thiga en 30 secondes : 

Thiga est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en IA et en digital. Nous accompagnons les plus grands groupes et scale-ups françaises : Decathlon, Doctolib, AXA, ManoMano, Mirakl, Disney, Leboncoin et une centaine d'autres. Nous sommes 200, majoritairement à Paris.
Thiga Academy, c'est notre organisme de formation. On y forme les équipes produit (Product Managers, Product Owners, Designers, Product Leaders) et celles qui veulent le devenir : product management, product discovery, leadership produit, et IA appliquée au produit. En inter-entreprise comme en intra, on transmet ce que nos consultants pratiquent chez nos clients tous les jours
 
Pourquoi ce poste : 

L'Academy forme chaque année 2000 professionnels et son offre est solide. Le problème : aujourd'hui, elle ne communique presque pas. Peu de contenu, peu de présence, une notoriété très en dessous de ce que le catalogue mérite.

C'est une page blanche côté growth, et c'est exactement ce qui rend le poste intéressant. On cherche quelqu'un pour construire, mesurer et faire tourner le moteur d'acquisition de l'Academy à partir de zéro : quels canaux, quels messages, quel funnel, avec quels résultats. Pas pour décorer le catalogue, pour le remplir.


Ce que tu vas faire 🖇

1. Construire et faire tourner le moteur d'acquisition, avec le Head of Marketing & Events

  • Structurer le tunnel d'acquisition de bout en bout : quels canaux amènent du trafic, ce qui convertit en lead, ce qui déclenche l'inscription

  • Tester des canaux et des formats en continu (LinkedIn organique et payant, email, SEO, partenariats, salons) et couper vite ce qui ne marche pas

  • Créer et itérer les landing pages du catalogue et des sessions, pensées pour convertir dès le premier jet et retravaillées à partir de la donnée

  • Mettre en place les séquences email dans HubSpot : nurturing, relances, réactivation des contacts dormants, avec un test A/B sur les objets et les CTA

  • Accompagner le lancement des nouvelles formations avec un plan d'acquisition dédié, pas seulement un plan de com

  • Créer les supports nécessaires au tunnel avec Figma (catalogue, plaquettes, brochures) en gardant en tête qu'un support existe pour convertir, pas pour exister

  • Représenter l'Academy sur des salons et événements, avec un objectif de leads qualifiés en sortie, pas juste de présence

    • 2. Mesurer, analyser, arbitrer

    Le nerf du poste. Sans mesure, pas de growth, juste du marketing qui se raconte des histoires.

  • Suivre les KPIs qui comptent à chaque étape du tunnel : trafic, taux de clic, taux de conversion en lead, taux de conversion en inscrit, coût d'acquisition par inscrit, taux de remplissage des sessions

  • Construire les dashboards HubSpot qui donnent une vision claire de ce qui marche, canal par canal, campagne par campagne

  • Identifier où le tunnel fuit et proposer les hypothèses à tester pour colmater

  • Faire remonter les résultats au Head of Marketing & Events pour arbitrer les prochains messages, offres et canaux, avec des chiffres, pas des impressions

    • 3. Faire vivre la marque et la communauté qui nourrissent le funnel

    L'acquisition ne marche pas sans contenu ni preuve sociale. C'est le carburant du tunnel.

  • Poser la ligne éditoriale et la faire vivre : posts LinkedIn, articles, newsletters, formats courts autour du product et de l'IA

  • Animer la relation avec les alumni et la communauté d'apprenants : témoignages, cas concrets, un bouche-à-oreille qu'on peut transformer en canal d'acquisition mesurable

    • L'IA n'est pas une option chez nous, c'est la pierre angulaire de notre façon de travailler, et on attend de toi que tu aies cette fibre. Concrètement, tu t'appuieras sur l'IA à chaque étape : générer et itérer des variantes de copies avec Claude, produire des visuels avec Nano Banana et Figma, des teasers avec HeyGen, ou transformer une transcription Granola en article et en carrousel LinkedIn. C'est ce qui te permet d'avancer vite et de tester dix fois plus d'hypothèses qu'une équipe classique.


    La stack que tu vas pratiquer 🧰

    Le growth marketing moderne, c'est une combinaison d'intuition testée par la donnée, de vitesse d'exécution et de bons outils au bon moment.

  • LLM et agents : Claude (Pro et Code), Gemini

  • Génération visuelle et audio : Nano Banana, Adobe Firefly, ElevenLabs, HeyGen

  • Marketing ops : HubSpot (CRM, marketing hub, workflows), Luma, Phantom Buster

  • Prise de notes et capitalisation : Granola, Notion AI

  • Vibe coding (en bonus, pour les profils qui veulent aller plus loin) : Lovable, Cursor pour bricoler des micro-outils internes

    • Tu n'as pas besoin de tout maîtriser à l'arrivée. On attend une vraie curiosité et l'envie de pratiquer, pas un CV exhaustif.


    Le profil que nous recherchons 🌟

  • Formation : école de commerce ou de communication, en M1 ou M2, idéalement avec une spécialisation marketing, growth ou entrepreneuriat

  • Pratique IA personnelle prouvée : tu as un side project, un compte ChatGPT ou Claude que tu utilises tous les jours, un workflow Make ou n8n que tu as construit, un agent custom, un blog assisté par LLM, un repo GitHub, ou n'importe quoi qui démontre que l'IA est dans ta vie.

  • Réflexe growth : tu penses en funnel avant de penser en campagne, tu formules des hypothèses avant de produire, et tester puis mesurer te vient plus naturellement que produire pour produire

  • Appétence data : Excel ou Google Sheets n'ont pas de secret pour toi, et l'idée de creuser un dashboard pour comprendre pourquoi un taux de conversion a bougé t'intéresse plus qu'elle ne t'ennuie

  • Fibre communication : tu sais écrire pour être lu, tu as déjà animé une page, un compte ou une communauté

  • Rigueur opérationnelle et sens du détail : tu sais qu'une séquence email qui commence par « Bonjour {prénom} », ça fait tâche, et qu'un A/B test mal cadré ne prouve rien

  • Sensibilité business : tu comprends les concepts MQL, CAC, NPS, et tu sais qu'une belle campagne ne vaut rien si elle ne remplit pas les sessions

    • Au-delà des hard skills, on recherche surtout quelqu’un de curieux, volontaire, débrouillard et qui n’a pas peur de proposer des nouvelles idées !


    Ce qu'on offre 🎊

  • Stack IA premium : Claude, Gemini, et accès facilité à tous les outils IA quand ils sont pertinents pour ton travail

  • Encadrement et présence au quotidien de membres de l'équipe marketing pointus sur les sujets growth, événementiel et IA

  • Cadence de suivi : 1-to-1 hebdomadaire avec le Head of Marketing & Events. Fonctionnement quotidien en équipe avec les autres Head of (Content, Design) et le CMO

  • Cadre de travail : bureaux 23 rue Taitbout (Paris 9), équipe marketing de 8 personnes

  • Rémunération : grille légale alternance, transparente dès l'entretien


    • Le process 🎢

    Envoie ton CV, un lien vers un side project ou portfolio (même bricolé). Pas de lettre de motivation.

    En termes de déroulé, tu auras : 

  • Un premier call avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager

  • Un échange avec le Head of Marketing & Event 

  • Un case study à préparer et présenter 

  • Un dernier entretien avec Hugo, notre CEO

    • Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse !

jobs.title: Financial Crimes Framework & Innovations Manager
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We’re looking for a Financial Crime Framework & Innovation Manager to lead our KYC Framework & Controls team in Pleo’s first line of defence. The team owns our financial crime framework across the UK and EU/EEA, covering KYC, AML/CFT and sanctions screening. You’ll lead a team of specialists while staying hands-on, owning change end to end across multiple entities and jurisdictions. Compliance is a given; the bigger opportunity is using AI and technology to cut manual effort and sharpen our controls. We welcome all backgrounds, so apply even if you don’t tick every box.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our DK/EEA MLRO and lead a remote team of five financial crime specialists. You’ll partner with Operations, who run our KYC processes, plus Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance and our separate transaction monitoring team.

What you’ll be doing

As a Financial Crime Framework & Innovation Manager, you will:

  • Own and evolve Pleo’s financial crime framework for KYC, AML/CFT and sanctions screening across the UK and EU/EEA

  • Lead and support a remote team of specialists, building trust and a real sense of team

  • Drive change end to end, from spotting the gap to embedding the fix with Operations

  • Use automation and AI to reduce manual effort and improve decision quality

  • Lead our move to a new screening vendor through to go-live

  • Shape our readiness for the EU AML Regulation

  • Manage regulatory audits and inspections, and help set the team’s annual strategy

On the roadmap: the screening vendor migration (go-live planned for Q1) and the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027. We’re also finalising a new financial crime operating model, so some responsibilities may shift.

What you bring


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Significant experience designing and improving financial crime frameworks, controls and operating models in the UK or EU

  • Experience across multiple entities and jurisdictions, covering UK and EU/EEA requirements

  • Experience managing specialists while staying hands-on

  • A track record of leading change end to end, from stakeholders to delivery

  • Demonstrable experience driving innovation, for example AI-enabled workflows or automated controls

  • The ability to turn complex financial crime concepts into clear, practical guidance

It’s a bonus if you have:

  • Led a screening vendor migration or a similar system implementation

  • Hands-on experience preparing for the EU AML Regulation

You might come from a fintech or a bank. If you’re from a larger bank, show us where you’ve owned broad scope.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You want broad ownership across KYC, AML and sanctions

  • You get energy from finding efficiencies and putting AI to work on real problems

  • You lead specialists by building trust and giving them room

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You want a pure people-management role. You’ll be in the detail as well as leading

  • You need fully settled scope. Our operating model is being finalised, and some responsibilities may move

  • You’d rather lead an office-based team. Yours is fully remote, and connection takes deliberate effort

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first six months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Take ownership of the screening vendor migration and lead it through go-live

  • Take day-to-day ownership of the EU AML Regulation programme

  • Bring your remote team closer together

Beyond that, you’ll lead the AI and efficiency agenda across financial crime, with room to grow your scope as the operating model matures.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we’re supportive of families and help you feel that you don’t have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  • Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  • Hiring manager interview: A conversation with the DK/EEA MLRO about your experience and leadership. 45mins.

  • Pleo Challenge: Walk us through the efficiency opportunities you see in one of our processes. 1 hour.

  • Peer interview: 1 hour

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

We are receiving a really high volume of applicants but can only select so many for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

You will report to our Group Product Manager from Integrations and will work closely with Product and Engineering to define requirements, make sound accounting decisions and support delivery across many different systems and data models.
You’ll also collaborate with external development partners and ERP vendors building on Pleo’s APIs, acting as a key point of contact to keep implementations on track and aligned with customer workflows.

What you'll be doing

As an Product Manager you will:

  • Own a portfolio of accounting integrations and partner relationships, balancing customer needs, partner requests and internal priorities.

  • Translate export, reconciliation and month-end close workflows into clear product requirements and integration behaviours.

  • Partner with engineers to define data mapping and implementation details across multiple accounting systems, data models and APIs.

  • Improve the integration set-up and configuration experience so customers can onboard successfully with fewer issues.

  • Act as a trusted accounting domain expert, making pragmatic decisions that improve data quality and reduce manual work for finance teams.

  • Support external partners and ERP vendors building on Pleo’s APIs, ensuring alignment on expectations, delivery and quality.

  • Track and improve outcomes such as export success rate, adoption/activation and integration-related support volume.

  • Experience managing external partners or senior stakeholders and delivering through influence.

  • Hands-on exposure to technology in a finance context (for example configuring accounting/ERP tools, working with integrations/data imports, or collaborating closely with technical teams).

Nice to have

  • Experience with European accounting and ERP systems, and/or an accounting qualification.

  • Partner negotiation experience and/or additional European languages.

  • Working knowledge of APIs, data mapping or implementation projects.

Why this role is a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You enjoy bringing real accounting expertise into product decisions and can explain complex finance concepts in a clear, practical way.

  • You’re motivated by improving workflows for finance teams and can connect day-to-day pain points to measurable outcomes.

jobs.description:
Account Executive

Festanstellung, Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ)

Deine Mission

Die Energiekosten in Europa sind doppelt so hoch wie in den USA und China. Gleichzeitig wird sich die Stromnachfrage bis 2050 voraussichtlich verdoppeln. Marktpreisvolatilität und zunehmende Komplexität werden uns erhalten bleiben. Damit steht das Rückgrat der europäischen Industrie unter Druck – und Unternehmen müssen jetzt handeln.

trawa entwickelt die Lösung: die erste integrierte B2B-Energieplattform, die Energiebeschaffung, Energiemanagement und die Steuerung von Flexibilitäten in einem Produkt vereint. Supply, Manage, Flex – kombiniert. Diese Integration ermöglicht Einsparungen von bis zu 30 % bei den wiederkehrenden Stromkosten und unterstützt Unternehmen gleichzeitig dabei, auf erneuerbare Energien umzusteigen.

Wir sind Europas am schnellsten wachsende B2B-Energieplattform. Aktuell sind wir in Deutschland und Österreich aktiv und planen, unsere Aktivitäten 2027 auf einen dritten Markt auszuweiten. Unser Ziel ist die europaweite Skalierung. Wir bewegen uns schnell – das Marktfenster ist offen, und wir wollen es nutzen.

Über trawa

trawa ist ein Scale-up mit Sitz in Berlin und rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, davon etwa 30 in Product & Tech. Bis heute haben wir mehr als 35 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, darunter eine Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde über 24 Millionen Euro im Mai 2025. Zu unseren Investoren zählen Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic und Tiny VC.

Wir suchen eine:n Account Executive, um gemeinsam die nächste Wachstumsstufe zu erreichen. Du berichtest an unseren Head of Sales und arbeitest eng mit unseren Commercial-Teams zusammen.

Die Position ist in Berlin angesiedelt. trawa ist ein Office-First-Unternehmen: In der Regel arbeitest du an fünf Tagen pro Woche aus unserem Büro.

Das Team

Unser Sales Team ist ein zentraler Bestandteil für den kommerziellen Erfolg von trawa. Vom Erstkontakt mit einem Lead bis zum erfolgreichem Abschluss mit einem Kunden, berät das Team mittelständische Unternehmen zu unseren ganzheitlichen Energielösungen.

Wen wir suchen

  • Ermögliche signifikante Stromkosteneinsparungen bei unseren Kunden durch gezielte Positionierung unserer Lösungen zur intelligenten Stromversorgung und Steuerung von Batteriespeichern

  • Kommuniziere den Mehrwert unserer Produkte klar und überzeugend, indem du die Anforderungen der Kunden auf kommerzieller und technsicher Ebene verstehst

  • Übernimm Verantwortung für Geschäfts- und Pipeline-Ziele: Aktive Steuerung und Erreichung der definierten Umsatz- und Wachstumsziele

  • Baue nachhaltige Beziehungen zu Entscheidungsträgern auf und entwickle Accounts eingenständig weiter

  • Identifiziere Cross- und Upselling-Potenziale und erweitere das Lösungsspektrum bei bestehenden Kunden

  • Arbeite eng mit unserem Vertriebsinnendienst zusammen, um effiziente und reibungslose Vertriebsprozesse zu gewährleisten

Deine Ziele in den ersten 90 Tagen

  • Du hast das notwendige Verständnis zu unseren Produkten, zum Energiemarkt, zur Sales Journey unserer Kunden sowie zu relevanten internen Prozessen aufgebaut

  • Du hast dich als fester Ansprechpartner für deine Kunden rund um unsere Lösungen etabliert - und berätst sie ganzheitlich und kompetent

  • Du hast mehrere Kundenprojekte bereits umfangreich entwickelt, sodass erste vertriebliche Erfolge zeitnah absehbar sind

Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft

  • Erfahrungen in der B2B-Kundenkommunikation, z. B. als Account Executive, Account Manager oder im Business Development Bereich

  • Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft bzw. Erneuerbare Energien ist ein großes Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (mindestens Bachelor)

  • Ausgeprägte Überzeugungskraft und ein sicheres Gespür für Gesprächssituationen

  • Interesse an energiewirtschaftlichen Lösungen und intrinsische Motivation, die Energiewende aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Starkes Organisationstalent und Fähigkeit, Prioritäten in einem dynamischen Arbeitsumfeld zu setzen

  • Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Warum trawa?

Wirkung: Europäische KMU geben jährlich zwischen 150.000 und 10 Millionen Euro für Strom aus – viele davon zahlen zu viel und sind an veraltete Beschaffungsmodelle gebunden. Mit unserem Produkt veränderst du unmittelbar, wie Tausende Unternehmen Energie einkaufen, managen und nutzen. Die Wirkung ist messbar, der Markt ist riesig und der Zeitpunkt ist jetzt.

Verantwortung: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine Themen und treibst Ergebnisse voran – unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund oder deiner bisherigen Berufserfahrung.

Lernen und Entwicklung: Wir stellen dir ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget und feste Zeit für deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung zur Verfügung. Dich erwarten Mentoring, vielfältige Lernmöglichkeiten und echte Perspektiven für deinen nächsten Karriereschritt.

Vielfalt und Inklusion: Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit lebt, und unser Team spiegelt das wider. Menschen aus mehr als 15 Nationen bringen unterschiedliche Sprachen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven zusammen. Bei trawa ist Familienfreundlichkeit auf allen Ebenen selbstverständlich – in unserem Team und in der Führung arbeiten Eltern. Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld ein, in dem alle ihr Bestes geben können.

Vergütung und Benefits: Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket mit Gehalt und Stock Options, 30 Urlaubstagen sowie zahlreichen Benefits. Dazu gehören Zuschüsse für Internet und Mittagessen, eine Mitgliedschaft im Sport Club, feste Lerntage mit jährlichem Weiterbildungsbudget, ein wöchentliches Team-Mittagessen und regelmäßige Teamevents.

Bei trawa bauen wir einen vielfältigen, inklusiven und authentischen Arbeitsplatz auf. Wenn dich die Position begeistert, dein bisheriger Weg aber nicht in allen Punkten dem Anforderungsprofil entspricht, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht bist du genau die richtige Person für diese oder eine andere Position bei uns.

Internship · Full-time · Berlin (HQ)

 

Our mission for you

Take trawa beyond borders!

As an Expansion Intern, you'll play a key role in taking trawa into new markets and will experience hands-on what it means to be an operator. You'll work across go-to-market, operations and product, and see up close what it takes to bring a fast-growing energy platform into a new country. Two markets, one mission:

  • Austria: trawa is already live here, and you'll help scale the market: speeding up growth, sharpening our local positioning and turning our Austrian presence into a success story.

  • The Netherlands: trawa is preparing its Dutch market entry, and you'll help lay the foundations from day one: understanding the market, positioning trawa, supporting our first sales and commercial activities, and preparing everything for launch.

We staff you on the market where your profile and our needs fit best. Either way, you'll build something that truly matters.

 
 

What you'll do, whichever market you work on:

  • Supercharge local go-to-market: You research competitors, help define how trawa wins in your market and support early customer acquisition. Your work directly drives our local growth.

  • Turn regulation into a competitive edge: Energy markets change constantly. You track legal and regulatory updates, work out what they mean for trawa and help us adapt faster than anyone else.

  • Build local operations: You support product rollouts, from contract frameworks to processes, and help adapt what works at our Berlin HQ to the local market.

  • Shape the product for new markets: You bring local customer and market insights into our product team and help make sure trawa fits the needs of businesses in your country.

  • Become the market expert: You run ad-hoc analyses, build market overviews and quickly become the go-to person for everything specific to your country.

  • Collaborate with leadership: You work closely with our expansion leads and senior leadership. You take ownership of your own initiatives and see them through from idea to execution.

  • You are a true team player: You understand that humility and performance go hand in hand, and that what counts is the overall success of the team.

 

Who we are looking for

Standout candidates who want to grow with us:

  • Advanced Bachelor's student, in your gap year, Master's student, or recent graduate with outstanding academic achievements.

  • You have a strong track record. Analytical skills, an entrepreneurial mindset and a high degree of independence set you apart.

  • You’re highly motivated, hands-on, and eager to take real responsibility.

  • You have first practical experience in a dynamic startup, top-tier strategy consultancy or investment banking.

  • You're curious about the energy transition and are not scared of legal texts.

jobs.title: Head of Operational Integration
jobs.description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.

We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover

  • Seven European markets live

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), offices in London, Mumbai, and Shanghai

$40M Series B just closed, $75M raised to date from Atomico, Project A, and Inven Capital, institutional financing from international banks.

We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

Acquisitions are our second growth path. We buy established industrial distribution businesses in the EUR 20-40M revenue range, owners and management stay on board, and we connect them to our platform, our procurement, our financing lines and our AI stack. Three deals are live, two are close to signature, and at run rate we intend to close around five per year out of a mapped universe of roughly 200 targets.

Role Overview

You own what happens after signing.

Origination, valuation and deal execution sit with the CEO and our senior M&A advisor. Your mandate starts the day a company becomes part of Andercore and it ends when that company runs better than it did before.

These are analog businesses. Fifteen years old, owner-led, hemdsärmelig, a well-run P&L and almost no technology underneath it. They are profitable, they are growing, and they are at their operational limit. Our hypothesis is that our platform, our purchasing power, our credit facilities and our automation take them past that limit. Your job is to find out on the ground whether that hypothesis holds, in which order, and at what pace - and then to make it happen with the management team, not to them.

We do not arrive as the saviour with the AI magic box. We say so explicitly to every seller, and you will hold that line.

What You Will Own

Holding Management from Day 1

  • Access to accounting and financials from day one, monthly numbers on a fixed close, one reporting framework across all acquired entities.

  • Set the baseline: revenue, margin, working capital, cash, customer and supplier concentration. No opinion without the number behind it.

  • Pick up the commitments made during due diligence and turn them into the operating rhythm of the first 100 days.

  • Run the portfolio as a financial participation first. Both companies are growing. Do not put anything into a skid.

On-the-Ground Diagnosis

  • Spend real time inside the acquired businesses and find out where they actually stand, which is never where they say they stand.

  • Map the connection points: procurement, pricing, inventory, sales productivity, logistics, financing, ERP, reporting.

  • Test our integration theses against reality, quantify the ones that hold, kill the ones that do not, and bring the correction back to the CEO fast.

Value Creation

  • Sequence and land the levers with the management team: central procurement, our credit and working-capital facilities, pricing, sales productivity, customer intelligence, automation of manual back office.

  • Decide with the CEO what gets centralized, what stays entrepreneurial, and what we take from them - the flow runs in both directions, several of these companies do things better than we do.

  • Track every lever against the original investment case in euros.

Owner and Management Relationship

  • Be the peer of a Geschäftsführer who built a EUR 30M business himself. Credibility comes from having done operating work, not from a framework.

  • Be the one who checks whether things are as good as they are described, and who says it out loud when they are not. The CEO stays the partner; you bring the uncomfortable version.

  • Manage expectations in the other direction too: we are not a service provider that solves the acquired company's problems for it.

Playbook and Team

  • Codify integration into a repeatable capability: Day-1 checklist, reporting standard, diagnostic framework, lever library, 100-day plan.

  • Make the fourth acquisition faster than the first, then build and lead the team that runs them in parallel.

Scope Boundaries / What This Role Is Not

  • Not M&A. No origination, no valuation, no LOI, no SPA. That sits with the CEO and our senior M&A advisor.

  • Not a PMO. Nobody here sends a 400-line integration plan with traffic lights to an owner-manager. That gets you thrown out of the room, correctly.

  • Not a consulting engagement. You are measured on the numbers of the acquired companies, not on the quality of the analysis.

  • Not a corporate integration role. These are not hierarchical organizations that execute what the centre decides.

  • Not a process you inherit. There is none yet. You build it.

What We Are Looking For

You are an operator out of a private equity value-creation or portfolio operations team, or a generalist from strategy and transformation with real time spent inside operating companies. Roughly eight to twelve years in.

You bring:

  • At least one integration or post-close situation you personally carried, where you can name the specific knotty problem you solved and why it worked. We will ask for that story in the first interview.

  • Operating substance: you have sat in procurement, pricing, supply chain, finance or sales of a real company, not only next to it.

  • Geländegängigkeit. You are comfortable with an entrepreneur who is highly intelligent, rough around the edges, and holds two cars and a boat inside the company. Nothing about that scenario throws you.

  • People work as roughly half the job. Influence without formal authority, because these managing directors did not sign up to be managed.

  • A strong observer. You read a business and a person quickly and accurately.

  • Fluent German and English. German is not optional; these conversations happen in German.

  • Fluency with modern AI tooling and the instinct to automate your own work. You do not need to be an engineer.

You do not need five PMI programmes on your CV. We would rather you had none than that you learned to fill in lists instead of thinking.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months:

  • Every acquired entity reports monthly on one framework, on a fixed close, with us having access to accounting.

  • Each acquisition has its integration thesis validated or killed with numbers within 90 days of closing.

  • The acquired businesses keep growing. No customer, supplier or key person lost to the transaction.

  • The first value-creation levers are live and their P&L impact is measurable in euros.

  • A documented playbook exists, and the next integration starts faster than the last.

Over time you own integration and value creation for the whole group at a pace of several acquisitions per year, and build the team that delivers it.

Package

  • Fixed base plus a variable component tied directly to the success of each integration.

  • Virtual equity in Andercore at the current strike, with meaningful upside if we build what we intend to build.

  • Direct work with the Founder & CEO, the M&A advisor, the Board and our investors.

Role Overview

As VP Engineering, you own the Engineering organization and turn our platform and AI vision into shipped systems. You report to the Chief Product Officer and partner closely with product, commercial, operations, and finance. You lead our Senior Product Engineers, Staff Engineers and QA, and work closely with our product managers, who own product and design.

This is an execution mandate. You carve our core systems into a modern platform, build our AI agents into one holistic system that runs the trade lifecycle end-to-end, and scale the teams that deliver it. You inherit a working machine at full speed: your job is to rebuild it in flight without losing a day of momentum. In your first year, the priorities are the carve-out of our transaction core and bringing our AI agents into one orchestrating layer.

Key Responsibilities

AI and Automation

  • Build our AI agents into one holistic, orchestrating AI layer across sourcing, pricing, quoting, sales, logistics, and financing.

  • Drive automation of the full transaction lifecycle, and own automation-rate and no-touch-quote targets as first-class delivery KPIs.

  • Work with our data team, which sits with the CPO, on systems that make our trade flows a compounding advantage, so every transaction makes the system smarter.

  • Keep us at the practical frontier of agentic AI: ship what creates leverage now, skip what is demo-ware.

  • Put the guardrails, evals, and human-in-the-loop controls in place so automation stays reliable where it matters most: money-touching and customer-facing paths, where a wrong output is a real loss, not just a bug.

Platform and Architecture

  • Own execution of the target architecture for the Andercore platform, the system of record for industrial trade.

  • Lead the carve-out of our transaction core into a modern, modular light ERP (a lean core system for our trade transactions), with a clear migration path and zero disruption to daily trading.

  • Shape the role of Salesforce in our landscape: decide what stays on the platform, what moves to the new core, and how the two work together.

  • Make pragmatic build-vs-buy calls within the platform strategy and keep technology cost per transaction on a falling curve.

  • Make new-market launch a repeatable platform motion: multiple geographies, currencies, languages, and compliance regimes, built in rather than bolted on.

  • Keep the platform ready to pass technical due diligence at any moment: architecture, data, and security in shape for the next financing round.

Engineering Organization and Talent

  • Lead the Engineering organization: onsite talent in Berlin and a nearshoring team. Team structure and ways of working stay in-house, and you manage the nearshoring team directly and actively, not at arm's length through a vendor.

  • Build lean by default. The goal is not to grow headcount but to build a small, high-leverage team and raise output through AI across the engineering workflow. You lead as an AI-first engineering leader.

  • Hire and develop senior engineering leaders, including 1–2 Staff Engineers who report to you and own architecture across teams, and raise the talent bar with every hire.

  • Build an engineering culture of ownership, speed, and craftsmanship: small teams, high leverage, no bureaucracy.

  • Stay hands-on: review designs with your Staff Engineers, pair on the hardest problems, unblock teams, and keep decisions close to the code.

Enablement and Data Integrity

  • Enable business teams to build and automate with AI safely. Set the paved paths, standards, and review practices that let non-engineers move fast without compromising quality, security, or the systems underneath.

  • Partner with the CPO, who owns data, on data integrity: build systems that keep one source of truth with clear access and quality controls, so that faster building never degrades the data the company runs on.

  • Make speed and safety one operating model, not a trade-off, and communicate it across the company so every team knows how to move quickly within clear boundaries.

Delivery and Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Act as technical sparring partner to the CPO on architecture, roadmap feasibility, and sequencing.

  • Translate the product roadmap into shipped software, and turn front-line needs from commercial and operations into delivery.

  • Support the CPO and CEO in technical due diligence with a clear, numbers-backed view of architecture, data, and AI.

  • Communicate technical priorities and trade-offs transparently across the company, so everyone understands what we build and why.

What Success Looks Like

  • Engineering operates with clear ownership and no loss of delivery speed.

  • Our transaction core runs on a modern, modular platform: the carve-out is live and the migration path is executed.

  • One orchestrating AI system increases automation rate and transactions per employee, quarter over quarter.

  • Technology cost per transaction falls while volume grows.

  • Architecture, systems, and AI stand up to any technical due diligence.

  • Hiring runs fast and consistently: senior hires close within six weeks, with one bar across interviewers.

What You Bring

  • Senior engineering leadership at scale, having run and grown multi-team organizations, ideally across more than one location.

  • Deep experience with transactional platforms, ERP-style systems, or comparable systems of record, ideally including regulated financial flows such as payments, lending, or KYC, and re-platforming or carve-outs in a live environment.

  • Hands-on track record shipping AI or ML in production, with a real sense for where agentic AI creates leverage today.

  • A demonstrated AI-first, lean mindset: you have applied AI in your own engineering organization to raise output without growing headcount, not just talked about it.

  • Strong architectural judgment, with security and data protection built into your decisions, and enough technical depth to stay close to the code.

  • The judgment to know where reliability must be absolute and where speed wins: you move fast on everything reversible and hold a high correctness bar on the irreversible, money-touching paths.

  • A plus: a track record of enabling non-engineering teams to build safely with AI, balancing speed

  • against quality and data integrity, and the communication skills to carry that across a whole company.

  • A plus: comfort in a company where operations come first and software follows, turning manual services into products.

  • A commercial mindset: you anchor engineering decisions in unit economics, working capital, and speed for buyers and suppliers.

  • A plus: experience with Salesforce as part of a larger system landscape.

Practical details

  • Location: Berlin

  • Process: conversations with the CPO, the CEO, Chief of Staff, and members of the engineering team.

Principalement dedié à la distribution, le déploiement, la maintenance et le service après-vente de robots professionnels, avec un premier focus sur les robots de nettoyage.

Dans le cadre du développement de notre centre technique en Suisse, nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) en robotique – Maintenance & SAV.

Votre mission

Vous assurez le diagnostic, la réparation, la maintenance, la configuration et la mise en service de robots professionnels de nettoyage.

Vous intervenez sur les différents systèmes qui composent les robots :

  • Électronique & électricité : batteries, cartes électroniques, moteurs, capteurs, LiDAR, câblages

Vous serez également amené(e) à préparer les nouveaux robots, effectuer les maintenances préventives, intervenir chez nos clients en Suisse et collaborer avec les équipes techniques de nos fabricants internationaux.

Requirements

  • Automaticien(ne) CFC

Une expérience dans la robotique est un avantage, mais n’est pas obligatoire. Une expérience en maintenance de machines, équipements industriels ou électromécaniques est également très intéressante.


Compétences:

  • Très bonne aisance informatique
  • Capacité à diagnostiquer et résoudre des problèmes techniques
  • Autonomie, rigueur et sens pratique

  • Allemand : un avantage

Vous rejoignez un projet en forte croissance et participez au développement d’un centre d’expertise en robotique professionnelle en Suisse, avec des formations auprès de fabricants internationaux et la possibilité de travailler sur de nouvelles générations de robots.

jobs.title: Senior Regional Account Manager Schweiz (m/w/d) Westschweiz Genf, Jura, Freiburg, Bern und Wallis
jobs.description:
Über uns

Die FormMed HealthCare GmbH entwickelt Mikronährstoff-Präparate für Therapeuten und Ärzte aller Fachrichtungen. Mit über 400 Präparaten bieten wir das größte Mikronährstoff-Konzept Deutschlands. Über 7.000 Ärzte, medizinische Institute und Heilpraktiker arbeiten mit uns zusammen. Das macht FormMed zur Nr. 1 bei Ärzten und Therapeuten in Deutschland.

Es macht Spaß, bei uns zu arbeiten! Das Arbeitsumfeld ist trotz komplexer Anforderung menschlich und humorvoll, geprägt von Eigenverantwortung, kurzen Entscheidungswegen, schneller Umsetzung, langjährigen Mitarbeitern:innen und einer Führung durch Vertrauen. Wir verkaufen Gesundheit nicht nur nach außen, sondern leben sie auch nach innen. Du solltest diese Unternehmenskultur zu schätzen wissen und Dich bewusst dafür entscheiden.

Wegen unseres stetigen und schnellen Wachstums suchen wir viele neue Kollegen:innen, die uns noch weiter voranbringen und gut ins Team passen. Wachse mit uns und profitiere von einem Umfeld, das Dir große Sicherheit und viele Chancen bietet.


Deine Rolle

Du möchtest einen Markt nicht nur betreuen, sondern aktiv entwickeln und nachhaltige Partnerschaften aufbauen? Du verstehst Vertrieb als Beziehungsgeschäft mit Sinn – besonders im Gesundheitsumfeld?

FormMed steht für hochwertige Mikronährstofflösungen, wissenschaftliche Qualität und das gemeinsame Ziel, Gesundheit nachhaltig zu verbessern. In einem respektvollen, lernbereiten Umfeld arbeiten wir täglich daran, medizinische Expertise zugänglich zu machen und echte Wirkung zu erzielen.

Als Senior Regional Account Manager Westschweiz (m/w/d) verantwortest du den strategischen und nachhaltigen Ausbau unseres Vertriebsgebiets in der Westschweiz mit den Regionen Genf, Jura, Freiburg, Bern und Wallis. Du entwickelst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen gezielt weiter, identifizierst neue Marktpotenziale und gewinnst neue Partner im Gesundheitswesen.

Du repräsentierst FormMed als kompetenten und verlässlichen Partner gegenüber Ärzt, Therapeut, Apotheken und weiteren Gesundheitsfachpersonen. Dabei verbindest du ausgeprägte Vertriebsstärke mit Beratungskompetenz und einem echten Verständnis für die individuellen Bedürfnisse deiner Kunden. Du erhältst viel Gestaltungsspielraum, arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und hast die Möglichkeit, den Schweizer Markt aktiv mitzugestalten. Dabei wirst du Teil eines Teams, das Zusammenarbeit, Vertrauen und kontinuierliche Entwicklung lebt.

Wenn du Vertrieb mit Purpose verbinden, Beziehungen aufbauen und einen Markt nachhaltig entwickeln möchtest, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.
Wir suchen ab sofort einen Senior Regional Account Manager Westschweiz (m/w/d) in unbefristeter Anstellung für eine Vollzeittätigkeit im Vertriebsteam mit Fokus auf den Schweizer Markt und insbesondere die Westschweiz.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst die strategische und operative Verantwortung für dein Vertriebsgebiet in der Westschweiz und entwickelst dieses nachhaltig weiter.
  • Dein Vertriebsgebiet umfasst die Regionen Genf, Jura, Freiburg, Bern und Wallis.
  • Du gewinnst neue FormMed-Therapeut und baust unser Netzwerk im Schweizer Gesundheitswesen gezielt aus.
  • Du bringst dein bestehendes Netzwerk aktiv in die Zusammenarbeit mit FormMed ein und entwickelst neue Kontakte zu langfristigen Kundenbeziehungen.
  • Du betreust bestehende Kund systematisch weiter und entwickelst erfolgreiche Partnerschaften zu loyalen Key Accounts.
  • Du übernimmst die Umsatzverantwortung für dein Gebiet und steuerst deine Vertriebsaktivitäten konsequent anhand relevanter KPIs.
  • Du entwickelst eigenständig Strategien zur Marktdurchdringung, Neukundengewinnung und Kundenbindung.
  • Du führst persönliche Beratungsgespräche mit Ärzt, Therapeut, Apotheken und weiteren Gesundheitsfachpersonen und bist dabei kompetente Ansprechpartner auf Augenhöhe – fachlich, vertrieblich und menschlich.
  • Du konzipierst und begleitest individuelle Angebote und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinen Kund passende Lösungen.
  • Du nutzt moderne Vertriebsinstrumente wie Microsoft Dynamics CRM, digitale Vertriebstools und KI-gestützte Anwendungen, um deine Aktivitäten effizient zu planen und erfolgreich umzusetzen.
  • Du beobachtest Markt- und Kundenentwicklungen in der Westschweiz, leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab und setzt diese eigenverantwortlich um.
  • Du identifizierst neue Marktpotenziale und entwickelst gezielte Strategien für deren Erschließung.
  • Du repräsentierst FormMed auf Fachveranstaltungen, Kongressen und relevanten Netzwerkveranstaltungen und stärkst damit unsere Präsenz im Schweizer Gesundheitsmarkt.
  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den nachhaltigen Umsatz- und Kundenaufbau in deinem Vertriebsgebiet.


Dein Profil

  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige, nachweisbare Vertriebserfahrung, idealerweise im Gesundheitswesen oder in einem vergleichbaren beratungsintensiven Umfeld.
  • Besonders willkommen sind Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Mikronährstoffe, Diagnostik, Arzneimittel, Nahrungsergänzung oder vergleichbaren Gesundheitsprodukten.
  • Du verfügst idealerweise über ein bestehendes Netzwerk im Schweizer Gesundheitswesen und zu Ärzten, Therapeuten, Apotheken oder weiteren Gesundheitsfachpersonen.
  • Du hast Freude daran, dein Netzwerk aktiv für den Aufbau neuer Geschäftsbeziehungen einzusetzen und langfristige Partnerschaften zu entwickeln.
  • Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im kaufmännischen, medizinischen oder gesundheitlichen Bereich ist von Vorteil.
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, strategisch und ergebnisorientiert und hast Freude daran, dein Vertriebsgebiet eigenverantwortlich aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Vertriebskennzahlen, KPIs und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge.
  • Du bist erfahren im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, idealerweise Microsoft Dynamics, sowie MS Office und modernen digitalen Vertriebstools.
  • Du überzeugst durch ein professionelles Auftreten, Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie und kannst medizinische und vertriebliche Themen verständlich und auf Augenhöhe vermitteln.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Französischkenntnisse und kannst Kunden sicher und professionell auf Französisch beraten und betreuen.
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse sind insbesondere für die Betreuung der Regionen Bern und Wallis von Vorteil.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich, bist gleichzeitig ein Teamplayer und bringst eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität mit.
  • Du hast Freude an persönlicher Kundenbetreuung und bist regelmäßig innerhalb deines Vertriebsgebiets unterwegs.
  • Du besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B und bringst eine hohe regionale Reisebereitschaft innerhalb der Westschweiz mit.


Warum wir?

  • Home-Office mit High-End-Ausstattung – modern, ergonomisch und perfekt für deinen Vertriebsalltag
  • Dienstwagen der gehobenen Mittelklasse – auch zur privaten Nutzung
  • Faire Arbeitszeiten & 25 Tage Urlaub – weil Work-Life-Balance für uns kein Buzzword ist
  • Attraktive Mitarbeiterkonditionen – z. B. auf unsere Präparate
  • Weiterentwicklung garantiert – fachlich wie persönlich, in internen Schulungen und externen Coachings
  • Ein Team, das dich trägt – regelmäßige Teamevents und ein wertschätzendes Miteinander inklusive


Wo soll ich mich melden?

Bewirb Dich jetzt und werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das Wissenschaft und Wirkung verbindet – mit Leidenschaft für Gesundheit und einem Arbeitsplatz, der inspiriert. Du möchtest mehr über FormMed und die Rahmenbedingungen erfahren? Dann ist Deine Ansprechpartnerin Tanja Seidemann (+49 160 / 94 16 18 07 ) aus dem People Team.

jobs.title: Inbound Sales 🇫🇷
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role

We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France.

Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals).

You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers.

At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base.

What does make this role exciting :

  • You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating!

  • The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements

  • You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot

  • You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members

  • You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects

  • We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market!

⭐ You will be a great fit for this role if you: 

  • Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills

  • Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects

  • Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems

  • Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team

  • Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

Finance & Strategy exists to enable better decisions, faster, at every level of the company, in a regulated, diverse and ever changing business.

We succeed when ambitious goals become credible plans, when strategic bets are grounded in financial reality, and when the entire company (not just Finance!) speaks the language of performance.

We set the right ambition, we monitor whether we're getting there, and we raise our hand when something needs to change.

We are not record-keepers. We are builders, partners, and challengers. We are looking for people who want to build, support decision making processes and challenge the status quo.

  • Steer performance through framing and implementing high-impact initiatives (e.g. procurement tool, pricing) and driving some punctual explorations (e.g. M&A, transformative partnerships, competitive intelligence)

  • Contribute to our investors relations and financing. This includes preparing Board meetings, fundraising, external communications.

To support the above, you will build, improve, maintain best-in-class tools for financial planning and performance monitoring, hand-in-hand with the Data, Business and Finance teams. This includes BP, monitoring dashboards, selection and implementation of third party tools where relevant.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing & Lead Generation
jobs.description:
Who are we?

moka.care is a mental health solution for companies, with one mission in mind: nurturing healthy minds to foster healthy organizations.

We guide employees through individual and group therapy or coaching sessions.

Alongside we help HR teams to take care of their employees’ mental health on a daily basis.

Where we are currently: Since our creation in December 2019, more than 400 companies (L'Oreal, Spendesk, Qonto, Engie, Castalie, etc.) have joined moka.care, and we now have over 300,000 employees covered in France but also throughout the world!

We have raised 17,5 million euros and are 70 to help companies improve their mental well-being.

What we believe in? Excellence in care is our obsession.

Culture is not nice words we put on the walls, we have defined 4 tangible values to make this culture live: Team Play, Optimism, Ownership & Agility.


Why do we need you?

Moka.Care has built strong foundations in a rapidly evolving market. We are now looking for a marketing leader who can scale our growth and pipeline generation efforts, strengthen our commercial execution, improve go-to-market effectiveness and continue building a leading brand for HR and People teams.

Reporting to Guillaume d’Ayguesvives, co-founder, you will own Moka.Care’s global marketing strategy with a strong focus on pipeline generation, revenue impact and commercial performance.

You will lead a multidisciplinary team of 8 people organized across three main areas:

  • Brand, Awareness & Customer Enablement, led by a Brand & Product Marketing Lead
  • Lead Generation, Content & Sales Enablement
  • BDR Team, led by a BDR Team Lead

You will also work closely with the Revenue Operations team to ensure strong alignment between marketing performance, pipeline generation and revenue outcomes.

This role is designed for a performance-oriented marketing leader who combines strategic vision with operational excellence, and who knows how to build scalable growth systems in B2B environments.

What will you do?

Lead a high-performing marketing organization

  • Provide clear direction, prioritization and performance management across the team
  • Coach and develop managers and senior contributors
  • Stay closely involved in execution, funnel performance and operational priorities
  • Strengthen collaboration across Marketing, Sales, Customer, Product, Tech and Revenue Operations teams

Lead Moka.Care’s growth and pipeline generation

  • Define Moka.Care’s growth and lead generation priorities across inbound, outbound, paid acquisition and lifecycle marketing
  • Scale a predictable and efficient pipeline generation engine aligned with revenue objectives
  • Improve acquisition efficiency, funnel conversion and channel performance
  • Partner closely with Revenue Operations to strengthen marketing performance measurement, attribution and budget allocation decisions
  • Strengthen alignment and operating rhythms between Marketing, BDR and Sales teams
  • Lead and develop the BDR Team Lead to maximize outbound pipeline generation and performance

About The Role

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. We’re an EMI-licensed fintech in a fully cloud-native AWS environment, we use AI heavily, and we’re growing fast. We need someone who can lead technical initiatives independently, influence our security architecture, challenge approaches that no longer fit, and explain it clearly to engineers and leadership.


Your Mission

Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority

  • Own SIEM alerting end-to-end: ship logs from endpoints, IdP, VPN, SaaS, and cloud; write and tune detection rules; cut false positives.
  • Act as first responder for security incidents — investigate, contain, drive to closure with clear runbooks — and feed recurring issues back into preventive controls.
Identity, Access & SaaS
  • Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations.
  • Hunt down over-permissive and stale access, enforce least privilege and PAM, catch SoD gaps, and make JML and third-party access work in practice.
  • Improve SaaS security posture (Google/Microsoft, Slack, GitHub, others) and apply DLP controls to limit data leakage.
Endpoint, Email & Phishing Defense
  • Keep the endpoint stack healthy and well-tuned — MDM, XDR/AV, device-compliance checks for VPN/ZTNA — and define posture requirements (disk encryption, EDR present, OS version) with automated remediation.
  • Defend against phishing and spoofing — secure email gateway rules, DMARC/SPF/DKIM — and run phishing simulations and security awareness, acting on the results.
Automation & Ownership
  • Build internal tooling and automate repetitive operations — reduce manual work, don't just operate it.

  • Practical experience securing how a company uses AI internally: shadow AI discovery, DLP for AI tools, controls for AI assistants and agents, and a working risk framework for adopting new ones. You've done this for real, not from a vendor pitch deck.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills — you build tooling against APIs, not just configure consoles.
  • Track record of driving improvements end-to-end and leading initiatives with little oversight.

Why Join Vivid?

  • Excellent relationnel : tu sais instaurer une confiance immédiate et créer un lien fort avec des entrepreneurs indépendants.

  • Véhicule de fonction + carte essence + badge télépéage

  • Organisation autonome. Tu gères ton agenda dans un cadre de confiance
